static_checks.message: Must check for stale SF data
Must use fieldkit pursuit health command
Local health scan must expose native qualification as unavailable
Historical local scores must not drive pipeline risk
Must use fieldkit pursuit forecast command
Must check contract end dates and flag expiring
Must use fieldkit pursuit projects command

evals.expected_behavior: Scans all pursuit files and returns a prioritized risk table based on timeline and Salesforce linkage, with native qualification unavailable because the local command does not fetch ClosePlan
assertions: Scans all active pursuit files across accounts
Returns a prioritized risk table sorted by risk tier (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
Flags pursuits with stale data or missing SF fields
Reports Native Qualification unavailable and does not use legacy local scores or arithmetic gate gaps

evals.expected_behavior: Runs fieldkit pursuit forecast, weights deals by stage probability, shows commit/best-case/pipeline scenarios
assertions: Runs fieldkit pursuit forecast to process all active pursuit files
Applies probability weights based on deal stage
Shows commit, best-case, and pipeline scenarios

evals.expected_behavior: Runs forecast with --quota flag, shows gap-to-quota for both commit and weighted scenarios
assertions: Runs fieldkit pursuit forecast --quota 5000000 (or equivalent) to incorporate quota target
Shows gap-to-quota for both commit and weighted pipeline scenarios
Shows commit, best-case, and pipeline scenarios alongside the quota gap

evals.expected_behavior: Runs forecast scoped to {{primary_account}}, shows weighted pipeline total for that account only
assertions: Runs fieldkit pursuit forecast --account {{primary_account}} (or equivalent) to scope to one account
Shows weighted pipeline number for {{primary_account}} pursuits only
Does not include other accounts' pursuits in the scoped forecast

evals.expected_behavior: Enumerates all project files, checks contract dates, flags expiring engagements, reports CU status
assertions: Lists all project files across all accounts
Ranks output: ZOMBIE first, then EXPIRING, SOON, ACTIVE (zombie evaluated before expired — zombie is operationally urgent)
Flags ZOMBIE projects (past contract end date AND still marked In Progress in Salesforce)

evals.prompt: what's expiring soon across my accounts?
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes as engagement-health trigger, shows projects by contract end date tier
assertions: Presents projects ranked by tier (ZOMBIE then EXPIRING then SOON then ACTIVE)
Uses project frontmatter (contract_end, sf_stage) to classify each project into health tiers

evals.expected_behavior: Scopes to {{primary_account}} only, shows project health tiers for that account
assertions: Scopes to {{primary_account}} only, not all accounts
Shows ZOMBIE, EXPIRING, SOON, and ACTIVE tiers for {{primary_account}} projects only
